lessonRef.unitTitle: Saving, Goals, and Keeping Money Safe
lessonRef.title: Mastery check: keeping money information private

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Financial Literacy elementary sequence — Grade 4
Manuel Academy Financial Literacy G4 Unit 4 — saving, goals, and money privacy
objective: Learners decide which pieces of money information are safe to share and which are not, and explain what makes the difference.
scenario: Imani is an invented fourth grader filling in a pretend club sign-up sheet. The invented sheet asks for a nickname, a savings goal, a guardian card number, and a password used at home. This is a practice sheet and no real number is ever written on it.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.
Leave every field on this practice sheet blank or filled with invented information; never write a real card number or password.

tasks.directions: Go through the four invented fields on Imani's sheet one at a time. Two are ordinary and two would give away something that protects the household. Sort them before deciding what she should do.

prompts.text: Which of the four fields on Imani's sheet should be left blank, and what do those fields have in common?

tasks.directions: Imani wants to join the club without handing over anything private. Write what she should do about the sheet and what she could say to the person collecting it.

prompts.text: What should Imani do with the sheet, and what should she say to whoever asks for the missing information?

tasks.directions: A form asking for something does not make it required.

prompts.text: Why is it worth pausing when any form asks for a number that unlocks money?

remediation: If a learner treats all four fields the same, ask for each field what someone could do with it if the sheet were lost, and sort by that answer.
extension: Ask the learner to redesign Imani's sign-up sheet so the club still gets what it needs without asking for anything private.
